# Furnisia

> Furnisia is a 3D/AR/VR room planner and furniture visualizer built with React, Three.js, and WebXR. Furniture retailers embed Furnisia directly into their e-commerce sites so customers can plan rooms and preview furniture in 3D and full-scale virtual reality before buying.

Furnisia lets anyone design a room from scratch or start from a preset template, arrange furniture in an accurate 3D scene, and step into a 1:1 scale VR walkthrough using WebXR-compatible headsets — no app install required.

## Core Features

- **Quick Start 3D Canvas** — jump directly into a default 3D room and start arranging furniture immediately.
- **Custom Room Builder** — parametric room creation with custom wall shapes, per-wall thickness, ceiling height, doors, and windows.
- **Smart 3D Furniture Snap** — drag-and-drop furniture placement with snapping to walls, floors, and other objects.
- **Room Presets** — pre-built room templates (e.g. Studio Apartment, Living Room) at defined real-world dimensions to start designing quickly.
- **WebXR VR Walkthrough** — full-scale virtual reality room walkthroughs directly in a compatible browser/headset, no native app required.
- **Cloud Save** — save rooms to the cloud and access them anytime across devices.

## Tech Stack

React 18, TypeScript, Three.js / React Three Fiber (R3F), Firebase, custom WebXR camera rigging. Deployed as a client-rendered single-page application.

## Who It's For

Furniture and home goods retailers who want to embed a 3D/AR/VR room visualizer into their e-commerce site so shoppers can preview products in their own space before purchasing, reducing returns and increasing purchase confidence.
